episodes.155113: A cold front generated a line of heavy showers that produced gale force wind gusts over the lower Maryland portion of the Chesapeake Bay during the early afternoon hours.
episodes.156232: Scattered severe thunderstorms in advance of a cold front produced damaging winds across portions of southeast Virginia.
episodes.156233: Isolated thunderstorm in advance of a cold front produced gusty winds across portions of the Chesapeake Bay.
episodes.156234: Isolated thunderstorm in advance of a cold front produced gusty winds across portions of the James River.
episodes.156570: A warm frontal boundary draped across central North Carolina on the 22nd was tied to an area of low pressure over the Great Lakes. This warm front moved northward during the day and early evening on the 22nd, resulting in a few isolated severe storms in Franklin and Nash Counties in central North Carolina. Several trees were reported down as a result of these isolated severe storms, causing some local power outages as well.
